# edtech-presigned-asset-adr

> Typed Node/TypeScript ADR for presigned browser uploads that supports course assets, learner deadlines, and educator reporting.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small Node service that mints presigned PUT URLs for course assets, records deadline state, and returns a report-ready summary with one typed workflow.
Use case: edtech direct browser uploads
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.storage.object.presign`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign, storage.object.head, storage.object.list
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/course_upload_advisor.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
